name: Worrysome Idol regenerates missing mana, not a flat share of maximum mana (#3105)
contract: Spell 706917's periodic aura triggers 504829 ("Energize 10% Missing Mana") every 10 seconds. Per the tooltip and the client's raw string, each tick restores 10% of the caster's missing mana: the deficit shrinks by 10% per tick, so the second tick's gain is 90% of the first. With the native ENERGIZE_PCT bug (10% of maximum mana, ignoring current mana) the two ticks gain the same amount, ratio 1.0. The 4% spell haste half (effect 1, native SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS) is untouched by this fix; it is asserted here only as a regression guard.

steps.label: The passive aura self-applies on learn
The 4% spell haste half (effect 1) is present and untouched by this fix
No energize from 504829 has happened yet
The first periodic tick restored mana
The second tick's gain is ~90% of the first (10% of a deficit that already shrank 10%), not the same absolute amount as a flat 10% of maximum mana would give
